slides.title: Catch the reflex
slides.body: "Oh, it was nothing." "Anyone could have." Notice how fast the brush-off comes out, often before you've even heard it.

slides.title: Write it down
slides.body: Think of one compliment from the last month you pushed away. Write the exact words someone said to you.

slides.title: Ask the real question
slides.body: If it were true, what would change? What would you have to stop believing about yourself?

slides.title: Try "thank you"
slides.body: Next time, say just that. Then stop. Notice what you feel in the pause where the brush-off used to go.
